title: Fourier coefficient from agreement count
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $f$ map the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\{-1,1\}$, and let $S$ be a set of coordinates. If $A$ is the number of inputs on which $f$ agrees with the parity function on $S$, then the Fourier coefficient of the real-valued version of $f$ at $S$ is $\bigl(2A-2^n\bigr)/2^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube of dimension $n$ to the two signs
